A '''pond''' was located on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Its native flora and fauna included [[Frog/Legends|frogs]], [[Unidentified butterfly-like creature|butterflies]], [[Unidentified umbrella-like creature|umbrella-like creatures]], and [[victoria]]s. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] visited the pond.
